What is the loss ratio on this policy?

The loss ratio on [ANT-HO-204585](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdxxAAC/view) is **2,008.9%**. Incurred losses are **$45,000** against an annual premium of **$2,240**.

All of the losses come from one open claim, [00002216](/lightning/r/500aj00003jLAOcAAO/view), for a burst pipe that flooded the finished basement:
- **Paid:** $5,000, an advance for emergency drying
- **Outstanding reserve:** $40,000

The claim is still Under Investigation. The adjuster is waiting on the mitigation invoice and the rebuild estimate, so the ratio could change when those arrive. The policy renews in **105 days**, on 15 Jan 2027.
